digest.component_or_area: bridge reconciler, store state, capability stamping
propositions: Bridge is hard-wired to one tracker project at three points (JiraConfig scalar, fetcher JQL pair, applier cross-project guard) preventing teams from syncing multiple projects against one codebase
One shared ticket store across N repos and N projects, with each ticket recording its source project and repo membership, eliminates differential-deletion failure mode vs per-repo project lists
Tri-state project field (absent=legacy, explicit-empty=never-sync, explicit-key=sync-there) allows zero-event migration of pre-feature stores to recorded legacy default via idempotent ensure unit

Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate configured project set for base JQL AND enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink maps) per project, merging results into shared snapshot keyed by issue to preserve cross-project enrichment fidelity
Outbound dispatch relaxes cross-project guard from single-project check to set membership, per-ticket project, and explicit-empty tickets produce no mutation
Store capability stamp atomic-commits multi-project-bridge when mapping holds >1 project, failing closed on older binaries while single-project stores remain readable by legacy binaries
